name: Sentinel Real-World Engineering Benchmark Dataset
description: 20 medium-horizon engineering benchmark tasks designed as an evaluation corpus across Rust, TypeScript, and Python. Actual executed empirical trials and observed telemetry are tracked in docs/validation/results.json.

tasks.title: Refactor session state serializer for structured error telemetry
tasks.objective: Refactor session state serializer across amux-core and CLI crates to support structured error telemetry with causal error chains (thiserror), updating all call sites and serializing backtraces when RUST_BACKTRACE=1.

tasks.title: Resolve generic lifetime and trait bound mismatch on Context::with_operation
tasks.objective: Diagnose and resolve generic lifetime and trait bound mismatch on Context::with_operation across dialect AST visitors, ensuring thread safety (Send + Sync) and satisfying compiler borrow-checker across AST traversals.

tasks.title: Upgrade tokio to 1.43 and tracing-subscriber to 0.3.19
tasks.objective: Upgrade tokio to 1.43 and tracing-subscriber to 0.3.19 across workspace Cargo.toml files; resolve any deprecated constructor invocations and trait signatures in asynchronous worker pools.

tasks.title: Fix arbitrary-precision numeric serialization edge cases for 128-bit integers
tasks.objective: Fix numeric precision truncation when parsing 128-bit signed integers into arbitrary precision decimal representations without loss of high-bit significance.

tasks.title: Add dialect roundtrip and diagnostic span verification tests
tasks.objective: Write comprehensive dialect roundtrip and error verification tests for invalid SSA identifier references in kaleidoscope toy language dialect, ensuring dialect parser produces actionable diagnostic spans.

tasks.title: Eliminate quadratic string allocations in terminal escape sequence parser
tasks.objective: Eliminate quadratic allocations and string copies in terminal escape sequence parser by introducing zero-copy byte slice windowing (&[u8]) and bounded stack buffers for ANSI color codes.

tasks.title: Migrate legacy RefCell mutability in attribute verifiers to thread-safe reader-writer locks
tasks.objective: Migrate legacy RefCell interior mutability in attribute verifiers to modern std::sync::RwLock / parking_lot reader-writer locks, updating all attribute implementations across pliron-derive and core types.

tasks.title: Fix combined flag option argument consumption precedence
tasks.objective: Fix option argument parsing when combined flags (e.g. -abc) include an option that consumes an optional argument followed by a positional operand. Ensure correct precedence and argument binding.

tasks.title: Refactor custom error map handling with contextual path metadata
tasks.objective: Refactor custom error map handling to support contextual path metadata and localized message interpolations across all scalar and composite validators (ZodString, ZodNumber, ZodObject, ZodArray).

verification.method: npm run test && npm run typecheck

tasks.title: Migrate legacy stream event listeners to stream.finished with AbortSignal
tasks.objective: Migrate legacy node stream listeners (res.on('finish'), res.on('close')) to stream.finished with AbortSignal support across middleware dispatchers.

tasks.title: Resolve recursive type inference depth recursion in TypeScript 5.5
tasks.objective: Reproduce and resolve strict TypeScript 5.5 type-checking error in recursive schema inference (z.infer<T>) where cyclic types cause 'Type instantiation is excessively deep and possibly infinite'.

tasks.title: Add test coverage for exitOverride during asynchronous signal interruptions
tasks.objective: Add comprehensive test suite covering edge cases of .exitOverride() when invoked within custom action handlers under asynchronous signal interruptions.

tasks.title: Resolve socket ECONNRESET race condition in test/res.sendFile.js
tasks.objective: Resolve asynchronous socket race condition in test/res.sendFile.js where fast client socket termination triggers unhandled ECONNRESET before pipe drain listener unregisters.

tasks.title: Fix unquoted non-ASCII unicode handling in HTTP redirect query parameters
tasks.objective: Fix URL redirection handling when redirect target contains unquoted non-ASCII unicode characters in query parameters; ensure PreparedRequest.prepare_url correctly normalizes and quotes without corrupting existing percent-encoding.

tasks.title: Refactor graph node serialization and export pipeline for streaming JSON-Lines
tasks.objective: Refactor graph node serialization and export pipeline to support streaming JSON-Lines alongside graphml export; decouple exporter interfaces from in-memory graph models across export.py, models.py, and CLI commands.

tasks.title: Upgrade urllib3 constraint to >=2.0.0 and resolve SSL/timeout changes
tasks.objective: Upgrade urllib3 constraint to >=2.0.0,<3.0.0; resolve breaking changes in SSL context configuration, connection pooling timeouts, and header immutability.

tasks.title: Resolve mypy --strict typing violations in AST analysis visitors
tasks.objective: Resolve mypy --strict typing violations across AST analysis visitors in visitor.py, adding proper generic type annotations for ast.NodeVisitor returns and handling Optional attribute lookups safely.

tasks.title: Optimize duplicate node identification with hash-indexed adjacency lookup
tasks.objective: Optimize duplicate node identification in large dependency graphs by replacing O(N^2) linear scans with a hash-indexed adjacency lookup table, reducing memory overhead and traversal latency.

tasks.title: Fix port collision race condition in live test HTTP server fixtures
tasks.objective: Fix port race condition in live test HTTP server fixtures (test_testserver.py) where port collision during concurrent test runs causes socket bind failures (EADDRINUSE).

tasks.title: Add cycle detection and topological ordering tests for mutually recursive imports
tasks.objective: Add comprehensive test coverage for cyclic module dependency detection, asserting correct cycle detection and topological ordering in graphs with mutually recursive imports.
